                                                                                
 Usage: agentarts [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                   
                                                                                
 AgentArts CLI - Huawei Cloud Agent Development Toolkit                         
                                                                                
 Build, test, and deploy Agent applications quickly.                            
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version             -v        Show version and exit                        │
│ --verbose                       Enable verbose logging (DEBUG level)         │
│ --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.    │
│ --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to    │
│                                 copy it or customize the installation.       │
│ --help                          Show this message and exit.                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ init     Initialize a new AgentArts project.                                 │
│ config   Configuration management. (alias: configure)                        │
│ dev      Run local development server.                                       │
│ launch   Deploy agent to Huawei Cloud or run locally. (alias: deploy)        │
│ invoke   Invoke agent with JSON payload.                                     │
│ runtime  Runtime operations (cloud only): invoke, exec-command,              │
│          upload-files, download-files, start-session, stop-session           │
│ destroy  Destroy agent from Huawei Cloud.                                    │
│ gateway  Gateway management commands                                         │
│ memory   Memory Space management commands                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
